user: How does the review process work and how long does it take?
answer:
Here is how disputes are handled, based on Verta's dispute documentation.

**Review timeline**
- **Card reason codes:** the review target is 10 business days.
- **Transfer reason codes:** the review target is 20 business days.
- **Complex cases with a foreign acquirer:** these can take up to 45 calendar days. You would be notified if your case falls into this category.

The documentation doesn't say which group goods_not_received falls into, so I can't give you a definitive target for your case yet.

**Case stages**
A dispute moves through these stages: open, under_review, provisional_credit, resolved_upheld, or resolved_declined. You can withdraw a dispute while it is open or under review. Withdrawal is final, and the same transaction cannot be disputed again under the same reason code.

**Next step**
Your dispute has not been filed. Filing is irreversible, so I will only open it once you confirm. Tell me if you want me to proceed with the goods_not_received dispute for the eligible transaction.

fragments.text:
Dispute handling process
## Withdrawing a dispute
A customer may withdraw a dispute at any time before resolution. Withdrawal is
final; the same transaction cannot be disputed again under the same reason code.

Dispute handling process
## Review timelines
The review target is 10 business days for card reason codes and 20 business
days for transfer reason codes. Complex cases involving a foreign acquirer may
run to 45 calendar days; the customer is notified when that happens.

Dispute handling process
## Case states
A dispute moves through: open, under_review, provisional_credit,
resolved_upheld, resolved_declined. Only open and under_review cases can be
withdrawn by the customer.

Payment dispute rules
## Reason codes and chargeback windows
Each dispute reason code has its own window, counted in days from the
transaction date. A dispute opened after the window closes is not eligible.

| Reason code | Window (days) |
|---|---|
| fraud_card_not_present | 120 |
| goods_not_received | 90 |
| duplicate_charge | 60 |
| service_not_rendered | 90 |
| unauthorized_debit | 56 |
